dominant_strengths: Evocative metaphor: git history as a star constellation creates strong visceral pull and conceptual cohesion with branch colors
Restrained dark palette with branch-coded pastels (blue/green/coral) reads as elegant astronomical chart
Light curved branch paths suggest gravity wells, giving motion-elegance even in a static frame
dominant_weaknesses: Severe label collision on the right cluster — 'c6b8d37 cleanup dead code', '97c9e48', 'skill update', 'rebuild x-post v3', 'd68bf44 HEAD' overlap into illegible mush
Vertical composition is squeezed to a thin band mid-canvas, wasting 70% of the screen and undermining the constellation metaphor
Type hierarchy is flat: hash and message share weight/size, so scanning commits requires effort
fix_priorities: Resolve right-side label overlap via staggered vertical offsets or leader lines so every commit is readable
Expand the constellation to fill more vertical space; let branches arc with real amplitude instead of hugging a baseline
Differentiate hash (mono, dim) from message (sans, brighter) to establish clear two-tier hierarchy
Add subtle commit-size legend or hover affordance so the varying node radii have explicit meaning
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral/reflective from the constellation poetry, but behavioral usability collapses where labels collide and hierarchy flattens.
rationale.intent_fit: Concept nails the 'commit-constellation' brief, but execution sabotages legibility at the very nodes a developer would need to read.
